description: Deletes one of Development's email templates (sign-in, purchase, plan-start, notify, notify-account, notify-event, email-person, inbox-reply) — the dashboard's own delete, at once, with no approval: Development's emails of that kind go back to Gemmein's own design. Never Live: Live's templates come from Development by go-live and promote, which add and update them and never remove one, so Live keeps its copy. put_email_template saves one again. On the founder's Logs.
name: dev_delete_email_template
title: Development: delete an email template
